name: Hotel Neri Barcelona
insider_take: This medieval palace turned luxury boutique hotel sits in the heart of Barcelona's enchanting Gothic Quarter, where Roman walls meet modern sophistication.
whats_special: Hotel Neri occupies a restored 17th-century palace directly facing the charming Sant Felip Neri square, one of Barcelona's most romantic hidden gems. The building seamlessly blends original Gothic stonework with contemporary design, while being part of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection ensures impeccable service and culinary excellence.
pro_tip: Request a room overlooking Sant Felip Neri square – the view of the ancient church and centuries-old plane trees is magical, especially at sunset when the golden light illuminates the medieval facades.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers stunning views over the Gothic Quarter's labyrinth of narrow streets. Step outside to explore the nearby Barcelona Cathedral (2-minute walk) and discover the tragic history of Sant Felip Neri square, where shrapnel marks from the Spanish Civil War are still visible on the church facade.
pros: Prime Gothic Quarter location steps from Barcelona Cathedral
Boutique luxury property with intimate atmosphere and personalized service
Beautifully preserved medieval architecture blended with contemporary design
Rooftop terrace offering stunning views of the historic district
cons: Small boutique property with limited room inventory
Historic building constraints may result in smaller room sizes
